subject: general
question: In Information Technology, what does DASD stand for?

options.text: Device for Access and Storage of Domain

solution:
The correct answer is __**Direct Access Storage Device.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****DASD**

__
 
• Direct Access Storage Devices are** fixed or removable storage devices.**
 
• It is a type of** secondary storage device** that **supports direct access to stored data.**
 
• Access methods for DASD include sequential, partitioned, indexed, and direct.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Direct access storage devices had been associated with** mainframe computers and other types of servers**.
 
• **IBM **is often credited with having coined the term** DASD to refer to HDDs, magnetic drums and data cells.**
 
• Now the term incorporates other device types including** SSDs, HDDs for personal computers and RAID storage systems.**​
